name: The key and the armies
summary: The three recovered fragments returned to the bronze dragon, and the scepter could be made whole. Beyond that personal journey, Horde and Alliance communities were gathering the supplies for a campaign in Silithus. The key alone was not the war effort. Workshops, stores and countless contributions prepared the force that would have to stand before the opened stronghold. Rival peoples worked toward the same threshold, without losing the histories that divided them. The coming battle required both the recovered artifact and the many hands that no single quest could name.
